description: This file defines a template class for deferred destruction of Mojo interface receivers, including a class for deferred destroyable interfaces and a set managing such interfaces with deferred destruction capabilities.

classes.name: DeferredDestroy
classes.description: An interface for objects that can be deferred destroyed, providing a method to notify when destruction can proceed.

classes.name: DeferredDestroyUniqueReceiverSet
classes.description: A class managing a set of Mojo interface receivers with deferred destruction, allowing for immediate removal on disconnection and deferred destruction of interface implementations.

classes.name: DeferredDestroyUniqueReceiverSet::Deleter
classes.description: A functor class converting a delete callback into a deleter for unique_ptr, handling immediate deletion if callback is null or canceled.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new deferred destroyable interface implementation and its associated Mojo receiver to the set.

methods.name: CloseAllReceivers
methods.description: Invalidates weak pointers, clears all receivers, and unbound interface implementations, effectively closing all connections.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the receiver set is empty.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of active receivers.

methods.name: unbound_size
methods.description: Returns the number of unbound interface implementations.
